failures.question: 首单在 2017 年上半年的用户，在 2017 年下半年是否再次下单？按月留存率是多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH 
-- 获取2017年上半年首单用户及其首单月份
first_orders_2017h1 AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_unique_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS first_order_month
    FROM 
        orders o
    JOIN 
        customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE 
        o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND 
        o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-07-01'
    GROUP BY 
        c.customer_unique_id
),
-- 获取2017年下半年这些用户是否有再次下单
retention_data AS (
    SELECT 
        f.first_order_month,
        f.customer_unique_id,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <= '2017-12-31' THEN o.order_id END) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS returned
    FROM 
        first_orders_2017h1 f
    LEFT JOIN 
        orders o ON f.customer_unique_id = (SELECT customer_unique_id FROM customers c WHERE c.customer_id = o.customer_id)
    GROUP BY 
        f.first_order_month, f.customer_unique_id
)
-- 计算按月留存率
SELECT 
    first_order_month,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(returned) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_rate
FROM 
    retention_data
GROUP BY 
    first_order_month
ORDER BY 
    first_order_month
LIMIT 6;

failures.question: 2017 年和 2018 年各月 GMV 分别是多少？并计算 2018 年相对 2017 年同月的同比增长率。
failures.generatedSql:
WITH m17 AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gmv
  FROM 
    orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
  GROUP BY 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)
),
m18 AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gmv
  FROM 
    orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018
  GROUP BY 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(m17.month, m18.month) AS month,
  COALESCE(m17.gmv, 0) AS gmv_2017,
  COALESCE(m18.gmv, 0) AS gmv_2018,
  CASE 
    WHEN COALESCE(m17.gmv, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(m18.gmv, 0) - COALESCE(m17.gmv, 0)) / COALESCE(m17.gmv, 0), 2)
  END AS yoy_growth
FROM 
  m17
  FULL OUTER JOIN m18 ON m17.month = m18.month
ORDER BY 
  month
LIMIT 12;
